client_target.source: Granola — Execução PoC (resumo colado pelo usuário, 2026-09-17)
client_target.note: Também relevante: contrato atual de URA (Instinct) ativo até abril/2027; contrato administrativo renova em 30/nov/2026 — pressiona a decisão Open CTI vs. Salesforce Voice.

derived.basis: Classified Multi-Cloud/Medium (Field Service + Service Cloud/Agentforce Contact Center Enterprise + Experience Cloud): 5 epics, 1 M + 4 L (heavily L-weighted vs. the row's typical 8-12 epic count — complexity-weight equivalent to ~7-8 typical mixed-size epics), 2 point-to-point integrations, no data migration — baseline 16-24 weeks. Adjusted: +15% custom UI/UX with no native pattern (E04 custom mobile LWC business locks, E05 from-scratch Experience Cloud guest tracking site) + +10% governance/audit-compliance overlay (open audit-trail requirement G0305, LGPD data-stewardship G0211) -> high end 24x1.25=30. Low end held at baseline; all 5 epics carry confidence: Assumed, which widens realized risk toward the high end in practice even though it doesn't mechanically move the floor.

range_drivers.driver: Guest-accessible citizen tracking link has no native Field Service/Maps feature — full custom build (Experience Cloud + LWC/Apex), and token security spec is unconfirmed
range_drivers.tighten_with: Confirm PRODESP's security requirements for the guest token (key rotation, signature algorithm) - G0517

range_drivers.driver: Dispatcher console + N/N-10 escalation logic sits on an open audit-trail requirement
range_drivers.tighten_with: Resolve G0305 (which fields need audit trail, retention requirement) before console build - may require Field Audit Trail add-on

range_drivers.driver: Mobile app's 3 business-rule locks (refusal reason, photo, geolocated check-in) are scoped as online-only; offline enforcement is a deferred assumption
range_drivers.tighten_with: Confirm offline-enforcement scope with client (G0413) - if required rather than deferred to Roadmap, this epic's build grows

org_strategy.note: RESOLVIDO 2026-09-17 (decisions/0002): Service Cloud ENTRA no MVP, escopado ao canal WhatsApp — Agentforce Contact Center Enterprise (50 licenças), Digital Engagement, 1 fila humana única 24x7, roteamento simples sem skills (premissa a revalidar). Confirma a proposta de arquitetura do BSA (v2, Renata Vendramini) quanto a MessagingEndUser/MessagingSession/Case sob Service Cloud. Exclusão geral de Service Cloud permanece só para casos de uso de atendimento amplo fora deste canal; Salesforce Voice/Native Telephony continua fora do MVP per decisions/0001.
